channel.title: The Flat Rate Dev
channel.description: Software development by subscription: one flat monthly fee, unlimited requests, one active at a time, built directly by the founder of Poket Dev. Short episodes on pricing, workflow, and scope.
channel.itunes:author: Poket Dev

item.title: What a Senior Developer Actually Costs
item.description: The fully loaded cost of a US senior engineer, about 18,290 dollars a month before a 13,500 dollar hiring cycle, next to a flat 5,995 monthly subscription with unlimited requests worked one at a time by the founder.

item.title: How the Queue Works: One Active Request
item.description: Unlimited request cards, exactly one active at a time, a visible Trello queue, code delivered to your own private GitHub repo, Monday through Friday with zero meetings, unlimited revisions, cancel anytime and keep everything shipped.

item.title: Scope: Python First, Cloud to Embedded
item.description: Machine learning, Django, FastAPI and Flask backends, automation, data engineering, scraping, AWS GCP and Azure, Terraform, Docker, CI, desktop and embedded, with JavaScript and TypeScript when the stack needs it. Real client work included.
